author: FineEnvs
description:
📊 Data Agent — Harbor (train)
	

Teach an agent to actually do data science. This is a suite of 5,000 hands-on
data-analysis tasks: each one drops your agent into a sandbox with a real dataset and a
question, and asks it to explore the data, compute the answer, and write it down. Every answer is
checked deterministically — no LLM judge, no guesswork.
It's packaged in Harbor format, so it runs as a
ready-made agentic environment.
